Title: App loads in the Shopify admin
Settings page saves a banner text
Steps:
open the app
click "Settings"
fill "Banner text" with "Summer sale {random}"
click "Save"

Title: Banner text set in admin appears on the storefront product page
Steps:
open the app
click "Settings"
turn on "Enable discount banner"
fill "Banner text" with "Free shipping over $50 {random}"
click "Save"
expect toast "Settings saved"
save the value of "Banner text" as bannerText
switch to storefront
go to the product page for "Test Product"
Teardown:
switch to admin
turn off "Enable discount banner"
click "Save"

Title: Disabling the widget removes it from the storefront
Steps:
open the app
click "Settings"
turn off "Enable discount banner"
click "Save"
switch to storefront
go to the product page for "Test Product"
reload the page

Title: Settings validation rejects an empty banner text
Steps:
open the app
click "Settings"
turn on "Enable discount banner"
fill "Banner text" with ""
click "Save"
Expected Result: expect "Banner text is required" to be visible
Teardown:
switch to admin
turn off "Enable discount banner"
click "Save"
